# Synchronize optional native shell state with Flutter readiness and preferences

## Platform difference

Adding native controls around Flutter introduces another state/lifecycle owner that does not automatically follow Flutter navigation or theme.

## Implementation

PixEz adds native HDS tabs and a bidirectional HarmonyChannel, then propagates light/dark/system preferences into UIAbility color mode and replays cached state when tabs are ready. KikoFlu later removes its immersive native shell and restores a minimal FlutterPage host. Etohos supplies PC status-bar controls and close-to-hide behavior, distinct from its phone path.

## Applicability

Native shells and status surfaces are optional product integrations, with product/API support to validate. The KikoFlu removal is an intentional reduction of integration surface, not current feature support.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

Native readiness can lag Dart preference changes. Avoid feedback loops, duplicate listeners and stale cached state. Etohos close-to-hide is not equivalent to guaranteed background execution.

## Verification

Test cold startup, theme changes before native readiness, tab/navigation synchronization, listener disposal, PC close/reopen and phone behavior.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
